Writing your dissertation abstract? Use this simple 5-part structure ✍️

1. Context: the topic and why it matters
2. Aim: what your study set out to do
3. Method: design, sample, data and analysis
4. Findings: your main results, stated clearly
5. Conclusion: what the results mean

Tip: give most of your words to method and findings. Most abstracts are 150 to 300 words, but always check your university's limit.

Free guide with 4 examples: fizbusinessolutions.com/blog/how-to-write-an-abstract

Planning a PhD? Your first email to a potential supervisor matters 📧

Keep it short (about 200 to 350 words) and include:
📌 A specific subject line, e.g. "Prospective PhD student: digital banking adoption in Saudi SMEs"
📌 Your degree, university and result
📌 Your topic in 2 to 4 sentences
📌 A real link to one of their recent papers
📌 Your start date, funding position and a clear question

Free guide with 3 templates: fizbusinessolutions.com/blog/how-to-email-a-phd-supervisor
